components.label: Clients
components.note: Three kinds of callers: the native mobile app, the desktop web app, and returning users carrying a session cookie.

components.label: Load Balancer
components.note: Terminates inbound HTTPS, routes each request by platform, skips unhealthy instances and keeps returning users on the same server.

components.label: Health Checker
components.note: Probes every backend instance and removes any that fail from routing until they recover.

components.label: Session Store
components.note: Remembers which instance owns each session so a returning user is pinned back to it.

components.label: Mobile Pool
components.note: Backend pool tuned for mobile API traffic, served from Zone A.

components.label: Web Pool
components.note: Backend pool that renders full web pages for desktop, served from Zone B.

components.label: Zone A
components.note: Availability Zone A: instances A1 and A2 are healthy; A3 failed its health probe and is out of rotation.

components.label: Zone B
components.note: Availability Zone B: instances B1 and B2 are healthy and give cross-zone capacity if Zone A degrades.

cards.title: Overview
items: One load balancer terminates TLS, routes by platform, avoids unhealthy servers and keeps returning users on the same instance.
